name: 4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce
author: Allan Porras

sections.description:
Accept one-time card payments on WooCommerce through 4Geeks Payments. The plugin creates a hosted checkout session and sends the customer to 4Geeks to pay. Card details are entered only on the 4Geeks checkout and are never handled by your WordPress site.

GET STARTED: Open a 4Geeks account.

Why Choose 4Geeks Payments for Your WooCommerce Store?

  • 💳 Hosted checkout with 3D Secure:
    Customers pay on 4Geeks’ hosted checkout page. 3D Secure and card validation are handled there, so card data never reaches your store.

  • 🌍 Cards from anywhere:
    Accept payments from customers worldwide using major card brands, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

  • 🏦 Payouts in supported countries:
    4Geeks can send payouts to bank accounts in the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area, Canada, and Switzerland. Customers can pay from anywhere. See supported countries for the full list and deposit currencies.

  • 💱 Multiple currencies:
    Charge in the currency configured in WooCommerce. If it differs from your payout currency, 4Geeks converts the funds. See supported currencies.

  • 📊 Console reporting:
    Track charges, customers, refunds, disputes, and payouts from the 4Geeks Console.

  • ↩️ Refunds from the Console:
    Full refunds can be issued from the 4Geeks Console or API at no 4Geeks fee. The plugin does not process refunds from the WooCommerce order screen. See refunds.

  • 💬 Documentation and support:

    • 4Geeks Payments documentation is available 24/7.
    • Get help through the 4Geeks support page.
    • Join the 4Geeks Discord community.

Plugin scope

  • One-time card payments through the 4Geeks hosted checkout.
  • No saved cards, subscriptions, recurring billing, partial refunds, or plugin-specific webhooks.
  • Requires an approved 4Geeks Payments account. 4Geeks approves digital products with instant delivery; physical goods are not eligible.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or later.
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • An approved 4Geeks Payments account.
  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Checkout Blocks are supported.

Clear, Transparent Pricing

There is no setup fee to use 4Geeks Payments. A per-transaction processing fee applies to successful card payments. See the current pricing for the rate, VAT, and currency-conversion details.

Install the plugin via the WordPress dashboard

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. In the left-hand menu, go to Plugins and click on Add New.
  3. Search for “4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce” (or simply “4Geeks” and look for the correct plugin).
  4. Locate the “4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce” plugin in the search results.
  5. Click the Install Now button. WordPress will download and install the plugin.
  6. Once the installation is complete, click the Activate button.
  7. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > 4Geeks Payments.
  8. Copy the API Key from the 4Geeks Console under Settings > API Keys (API & Webhooks tab) and paste it into the plugin settings.

Follow this guide.

Manual installation

  1. Make sure that you have at least PHP version 7.4, WordPress 5.8, and WooCommerce 5.0.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then activate the plugin.
  4. Add your API key in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > 4Geeks Payments.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the 4Geeks API to process online payments.

Data sent to this service includes the WooCommerce order number, total amount, currency,
a short order description, the names of the purchased products, and the URL where the
customer returns after paying. Card data is entered only on the hosted 4Geeks checkout page
and is never handled by this plugin.

The plugin receives the checkout session status and transaction identifier to update the
order status within WooCommerce.

Privacy Policy of the external service can be found at: https://4geeks.io/privacy
sections.changelog:
2.3.3

  • Fixed the broken header in the translation template and refreshed the source references of every string.
  • Updated the Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian catalogues to the current version.
  • Polished Spanish and German wording for consistency with WooCommerce terminology.
  • Regenerated the regional catalogues (Latin American Spanish, Austrian/Swiss German, Canadian/Belgian French and Swiss Italian) from their base language.

2.3.2

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.

2.3.1

  • Removed the WordPress.org directory assets (banner and icon) from the plugin package; they are published through the plugin repository assets only.
  • Added nonce and permission checks to the payment return handler.
  • Order status is now taken exclusively from the 4Geeks Payments API, so a forged return URL can no longer mark an order as failed.

2.3.0

  • Added Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian translations.
  • Added regional catalogues for Latin American Spanish, Austrian/Swiss German, Canadian/Belgian French and Swiss Italian.
  • Updated the translation template with the current API key wording.

2.2.0

  • Replaced the legacy authentication flow with API Key authentication (X-Api-Key).
  • Create hosted checkout sessions through POST /v1/payments/session.
  • Verify every payment against the API before completing an order, including amount and currency.
  • Fixed the checkout nonce bug that blocked every payment.
  • Added WooCommerce Checkout Blocks support and removed the forced checkout page rewrite.
  • Added High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility.
  • Added automatic status reconciliation through Action Scheduler / WP-Cron.
  • Removed the third-party redirect from the customer flow.
  • Fixed a fatal error that could occur when the plugin was activated without WooCommerce active.
  • Fixed every translatable string to use the payments4g-4geeks-payments text domain.
  • Fixed translation file names and updated the deployment pipeline.

2.1.10

  • Multiple fixes

2.1.9

  • Best practices
  • Support multiple languages

2.1.8

  • Fixes and performance improved

2.1.7

  • Ready for WP 6.8.2 and WC 10.0.4

2.1.6

  • Fixes on testing payments
  • Readme update to show the new pricing model

2.1.5

  • Installation guide updated

2.1.4

  • Plugin description update

2.1.3

  • WordPress 6.8.1 and WooCommerce 9.8.3 compatibility
  • Security improvements
  • Error messages updated

2.1.2

  • WordPress and WooCommerce compatibility
  • Security improvements
  • Error messages updated

2.1.1

  • Security improvements

2.1.0

  • 3D-Secure implementation
  • Updates on readme

  • 3D-Secure implementation
